structured_output.what_is_happening: A pump.fun bonding-curve coin, "Be like Jacob" ($Jacob), created 2026-09-10 and quiet for about 15 days, suddenly traded about 400+ times and about $21-28k of volume in a single 5-minute window. Price rose roughly 60-90% over the hour, to about $15-17.5k market cap. By T2 the 5-minute change had already turned negative (-14% to -16%). The reference is Jacob Coxon, a former Anthropic/OpenAI safety researcher. His resignation tweet on Sept 8, 2026 went viral (about 76M views), and he has since appeared on ABC, CBS, PBS, TIME and Scientific American. The token's website link is a GitHub profile for "jakecoxon", and its X link is a status by @ThomasKDunne, an account GMGN shows was renamed from BrianDelany. GMGN flags the token as a community takeover (CTO). Many same-name tokens were launched Sept 9-10. One (Ac6u…) reached about $2M market cap and now has essentially zero liquidity, and a newer copy is named "WENT 8M ON RH". So this is a late, non-canonical copy being revived.

narrative.description: Jacob Coxon, the AI-safety researcher who quit Anthropic warning that AI companies are 'gambling with our lives'. It is a real, mainstream, still-reported story (ABC, CBS, PBS, TIME, SciAm). 'Be like Jacob' is the memecoin framing.
narrative.why_spreading: The story is real and was very viral around Sept 8-10, with follow-up TV interviews since. But the memecoin wave on this name peaked around Sept 9-10. Its leading token hit about $2M and is now dead. I found no fresh catalyst today that would explain why this token's volume jumped.

authenticity.evidence: After 15 days of dormancy, almost all lifetime transactions (about 410 of about 500) happened in one 5-minute window, split nearly 50/50 between buys and sells. That fits volume bots or a bundled push. GMGN counts 136 bundler-tagged wallets, a top bundler trader share of 36%, and a bot/degen rate of 56.5%. The creator has launched 299 tokens and has closed out. The linked X account is recycled (renamed). I found no organic mentions of the contract or ticker in web search.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is poorly indexed and I could not fetch the linked X post (HTTP 402). A real call-channel or KOL push, or a fresh Coxon news moment, could exist without showing up in my searches. GMGN counts 7 smart wallets and 2 renowned (KOL) wallets.

Serial deployer with 299 launches; creator has closed out, so this runs as a CTO revival
